title: Backblaze B2 Event Notification Rules
description: Event notification rules for a Backblaze B2 bucket. Masked secret values are preserved when left unchanged.

name.description: Unique name for this notification rule.

eventTypes.description: B2 event types that trigger this rule.

isEnabled.description: Whether this rule is actively sending notifications.

isSuspended.description: Whether B2 has suspended this rule due to delivery failures.

objectNamePrefix.description: Only events for objects with this prefix trigger the rule. Use an empty string to match every object.

suspensionReason.description: Reason for suspension, or an empty string if not suspended.

url.description: Webhook URL that receives event notifications.

hmacSha256SigningSecret.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. Leave __B2_CONFIG_MASKED_SECRET__ unchanged to preserve the existing secret.

hmacSha256.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. Leave __B2_CONFIG_MASKED_SECRET__ unchanged to preserve the existing secret.

customHeaders.description: Optional custom webhook request headers. Header values are masked on read.
